# Monserrat Molina Ramirez

> Portfolio of Monserrat Molina Ramirez, a visual designer based in Mexico City specializing in brand identity, website design, and presentation systems for growing teams.

## Pages

- [Home](https://monmolina.com/): Overview of Monserrat's work as a visual designer across brand, web, and presentation systems.
- [About](https://monmolina.com/about.html): Background, experience, and design approach.

## Case Studies

- [Tomorrow Problem](https://monmolina.com/case-studies/tomorrow-problem.html): Brand campaign design for Prezi's AI feature, spanning video, email, and product templates.
- [Growth Process](https://monmolina.com/case-studies/growth-process.html): Redesigning an internal growth and workflow process.
- [Evolution of Templates](https://monmolina.com/case-studies/template-evolution.html): Building a reusable, evolving presentation template system.
